tests.report:
Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; at least one pair of consecutive screenshots shows each train moving in its own sense; the trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: After Stop (app was 'In Fahrt'), stop lists already correct, Start clicked (badge 'In Fahrt'). In all five screenshots (after 10 s, then every 5 s) neither marker is on the main loop: 'Bahn 1' stays at Weiche 2 on the lower siding, 'Bahn 2' stays on the siding near the calibration point and only drifts a few pixels. Both speed readouts show 0. The operation log shows Bahn 2 repeating 'fährt weiter' / 'weicht aus' / 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' about every 12 s, Bahn 1 only 'wartet'. Neither train entered the loop, so no direction of travel could be observed; the trains are effectively deadlocked around the siding.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Before the test the 'Weichen' column 'Applied switch changes (oldest first)' had 12 entries and 'Messages from clients' read 'applied: 11'. In the app (badge 'In Fahrt') Stop was clicked, stop lists were already correct, Start was clicked and 2 x 30 s waited. The console then showed exactly the same 12 entries and still 'applied: 11': no switch changes after Start. The app still showed 'In Fahrt' but Bahn 1 speed was 0 and the track plan showed unchanged switch states.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: Stop clicked (badge was 'In Fahrt'), stop lists already correct, Start clicked (log 'Start' 13:16:26), about 2 min 10 s waited. Log since Start: 13:16:26 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 2 wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'; 13:16:27 'Bahn 1 wartet'; from 13:16:38 to 13:18:27 the same three entries repeat every 12 s: 'Bahn 2 fährt weiter', 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 2 wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'. No '… erreicht …' entry for either train; Bahn 1 never continued, Bahn 2 loops. Badge 'In Fahrt', speed of Bahn 2 is 0: deadlock not resolved.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Stop clicked (badge was 'In Fahrt'), stop lists already correct, Start clicked, three screenshots after 8 s each. All three show the same picture: both markers on the same lower track (siding between Weiche 2 and the Kalibrierpunkt), 'Bahn 1' at Weiche 2 and 'Bahn 2' at the Kalibrierpunkt; markers do not overlap but share that section. Neither marker moved, Bahn 2 speed 0. Log repeats 'Bahn 2 fährt weiter / weicht aus / wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' every 12 s, 'Bahn 1 wartet' once. No train ever passed the other.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2'
Observed failure: Stop clicked (badge was 'In Fahrt'), stop lists already correct, Start clicked (log 'Start' 13:20:47); final snapshot about 2 min 40 s after Start. No 'Bahn 1 erreicht ...' entry at all; the only Bahn 1 entry is 'Bahn 1 wartet' at 13:20:48. After that only Bahn 2 repeating 'fährt weiter', 'weicht aus', 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' about every 12 s, no 'Bahn 2 erreicht ...' either. Bahn 1 speed stayed 0.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history of this train shows, after entries with its normal speed, a new entry with the low calibration speed, followed later by its normal speed again
Observed failure: Stop clicked (badge was 'In Fahrt'), stop lists already correct, Start clicked (log 'Start' 13:24:34), 4 x 30 s waited. Log entries since Start: 'Bahn 2 weicht aus', 'Bahn 2 wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', 'Bahn 1 wartet' (13:24:35), then every ~12 s 'Bahn 2 fährt weiter / weicht aus / wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'. No 'wird kalibriert' / 'ist kalibriert' entry for either train. Mock console: Bahn 1 history shows calibration speed 60 only in earlier start phases, no low-speed entry between normal-speed entries during operation; Bahn 2 history column empty (counter 'applied: 180'). Both trains at speed 0.
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: The log shows, from old to new, 'Start', 'Stop' and 'Start' again, and after the second 'Start' at least one new entry '<train> erreicht <stop>'
Observed failure: Stop lists already correct; Start, 20 s, Stop, 3 s, Start, 60 s. The log shows the right order 'Start' (13:31:22), 'Stop' (13:31:52), 'Start' (13:32:02) and the badge returned to 'In Fahrt', but no 'erreicht' entry appeared after the second Start. Only 'Bahn 2 weicht aus' (twice), 'Bahn 1 wartet', then 'Bahn 2 fährt weiter / weicht aus / wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' repeating about every 12 s up to 13:33:07. Bahn 2 speed 0 throughout.
Steps completed before failure: 13
